At MSU GIS Day, Rural Montana Students Learn About Mapping Skills and Career Paths

2026-07-08 Montana State University GIS Day, Montana State University, rural students, mapping skills, career paths, Geographic Information System, GIS education, STEM outreach, workforce development
Read the source article

Quick summary

Montana State University hosts GIS Day to introduce rural Montana students to Geographic Information System technology, mapping skills, and potential career paths in the growing geospatial industry.

Key takeaways

  • Montana State University organized GIS Day to teach rural Montana students about mapping skills and career opportunities
  • GIS (Geographic Information System) is the technology that powers navigation devices, smartphone local searches, and spatial analysis
  • Event aimed at bridging the geographic opportunity gap for rural students in technology education
  • Exposed students to practical applications of GIS in navigation, urban planning, environmental management, and agriculture
  • Part of broader STEM workforce development efforts connecting rural students to geospatial technology careers
